dataset.excerpt: We conduct experiments on five datasets containing human organ and phantom data. Details are listed in Table 1.

dataset.v: chest、jaw、foot、abdomen；chest来自LIDC-IDRI，其余来自Open Scientific Visualization Datasets
dataset.excerpt: We evaluate our method using public datasets of human organ CTs [4,12], including chest, jaw, foot and abdomen. The chest data are from LIDC-IDRI dataset [4], and the rest are from Open Scientific Visualization Datasets [12].

dataset.v: 用GE C-arm Medical System扫描silicon aortic phantom；582张500×500 fluoroscopy projections；primary angle -103°到93°，secondary angle 0°；内置算法生成512×512×510 CT作为ground truth；实验只用50 projections
dataset.excerpt: We collect a phantom dataset by scanning a silicon aortic phantom with GE C-arm Medical System. This system captures 582 500×500 fluoroscopy projections with position primary angle from -103◦to 93◦and position secondary angle of 0◦. A 512×512×510 CT image is also generated with inbuilt algorithms as the ground truth. We only use 50 projections for experiments.

acquisition.excerpt: Since these datasets only provide volumetric CT scans, we generate projections by a tomographic toolbox TIGRE [5].
In TIGRE [5], we capture 50 projections with 3% noise in the range of 180◦.
This system captures 582 500×500 fluoroscopy projections with position primary angle from -103◦to 93◦and position secondary angle of 0◦.

acquisition.v: sparse-view CBCT reconstruction，输入为10× fewer views；实验用50 projections
acquisition.excerpt: The inputs of sparse-view CBCT are 10× fewer.

training.excerpt: Our proposed method is implemented in PyTorch [17].

training.excerpt: The sampling quantity of each ray depends on the size of CT data. For example, we sample 192 points along each ray for the 128×128×128 chest CT.

loss.excerpt: NAF is updated by minimizing the L2 loss between real and synthesized projections.

loss.v: L(Θ,Φ)=Σ_{r∈B}||Ir(r)−Is(r)||²，B为ray batch，Ir和Is分别为real和synthesized projections
loss.excerpt: L(Θ,Φ) = r∈B ∥Ir (r)−Is(r)∥2 , (3) where B is a ray batch, and Ir and Is are real and synthesized projections for ray r respectively.

baselines.excerpt: FDK [7] is firstly chosen as a representative of analytical methods.
The second method SART [2] is a robust iterative reconstruction algorithm.

baselines.v: iterative method with total-variation regularizer，引用[20]
baselines.excerpt: ASD-POCS [20] is another iterative method with a total-variation regularizer.

baselines.v: CBCT variant of IntraTomo [28]，frequency-encoding deep learning方法
baselines.excerpt: We implement a CBCT variant of IntraTomo [28], named IntraTomo3D, as an example of frequency-encoding deep learning methods.

metrics.excerpt: We evaluate five methods quantitatively in terms of peak signal-to-noise ratio (PNSR) and structural similarity (SSIM) [25].

metrics.v: 统计评估artifact suppression性能，单位dB
metrics.excerpt: PSNR (dB) statistically assesses the artifact suppression performance, while SSIM measures the perceptual difference between two signals.

metrics.v: 衡量两个信号之间的感知差异
metrics.excerpt: PSNR (dB) statistically assesses the artifact suppression performance, while SSIM measures the perceptual difference between two signals.
Higher PNSR/SSIM values represent the accurate reconstruction and vice versa.

results.excerpt: For example, the PSNR value of our method in the abdomen dataset is 3.07 dB higher than that of the second-best method SART.

results.v: NAF与iterative方法耗时相近，比IntraTomo3D快3×；IntraTomo3D需超过1小时训练
results.excerpt: IntraTomo3D requires more than one hour to train the network. Benefiting from the compact network design, NAF spends similar running time to iterative methods and is 3×faster than the frequency-encoding deep learning method IntraTomo3D.
